claims.object_text: early-onset seizure and epileptic encephalopathy associated with intellectual disability
claims.quote: SLC6A1 is associated with an autosomal dominant early-onset seizure and epileptic encephalopathy associated with intellectual disability.
Structural and evolutionary assessments establish this variant as a loss of function to the protein.
The patient was resistant to multiple epileptic drugs, finally finding that valproic acid controls the seizures.
